shared_or_similar_visual_information: A fill selecting one side of a visible geometric or plotted boundary. On the left, use the gray half-plane below the rising solid line. On the right, use the blue region inside the circle and outside the white triangle.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: It marks the points satisfying the non-strict linear inequality, including its boundary. Right image: The fill selects the disk with the inscribed triangular part excluded.
Rationales: The shaded half-plane records which coordinate pairs meet an inequality. The geometric fill delimits a measured area after removing the depicted cutout or excluded portion.
